doubts: The page describes two separate walks (the 1 hr Denniston Brakehead Walk loop and the 5 min accessible walk from the lower car park to the Denniston Incline viewpoint), so it is a network with the Brakehead Walk as the main way; it could instead be read as one walk with two parts. Neither the main Denniston car park (reached via Boswell Street) nor the lower car park clearly matches any road-end feature (the features name Young Street, Burnetts Face Road and Denniston Road, not Boswell Street), so starts and ends are null. The text does not say where the Banbury Arches side trip leaves the loop (it is described after The Camp), so its from is null. The Denniston Incline viewpoint is in W1 as a side trip from the top of the incline and is also the end of W2.
